author: cairn
blurb: Search movies and TV shows and fetch details from The Movie Database. Requires a free API token.

definition.name: The Movie Database (TMDB)
definition.description: Search movies and TV shows and retrieve details, ratings, and release dates via TMDB.

operations.name: search_movies
operations.toolDefinition: {"name":"search_movies","description":"Search movies by title on TMDB.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string","description":"Movie title"},"year":{"type":"number","description":"Release year filter (optional)"}},"required":["query"]}}

operations.name: search_tv
operations.description: Search for TV shows by name.
operations.toolDefinition: {"name":"search_tv","description":"Search TV shows by name on TMDB.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string","description":"Show name"}},"required":["query"]}}

operations.name: get_movie_details
operations.description: Get full details for a movie by its TMDB id.
operations.toolDefinition: {"name":"get_movie_details","description":"Get movie details by TMDB movie id.","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"movie_id":{"type":"number","description":"TMDB movie id"}},"required":["movie_id"]}}
